method: Re-extracted the separately retrieved adopted regulations, reconciled the dated catalogue and named course-entry conditions, then read the frozen decision, content and schedules against the underlying workbooks and course descriptions.
findings: The regular curriculum has 150 compulsory EC plus 30 EC of structured choice. Passing the first two years satisfies the named 120 EC thesis threshold. The thesis also requires an approved study programme and registration. The first-year research and statistics courses precede higher-year methods and analytics. The November erratum does not change this programme.

The broad option provides financial markets and qualitative research as well as management and strategy. The digital option adds programming, models and ethics. The finance option adds macroeconomics, banking, econometrics and public policy. Each schedule follows the active workbook. The 10 EC thesis is separate from taught analytics and the UCR optional research contributes no scheduled credits.

Market valuation aligns most directly with Finance and Investment. Multinational financial management, supply chains, firm location and the thesis remain visible as specialist requirements. Reader-facing course titles, comparative claims and links agree with the reviewed content.
